हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A devoted father, Raj, is humiliated for his modest life—until the shocking truth reveals he is actually Prince Singhai, a powerful business tycoon. As he secretly supports his wife Latika’s success while hiding his identity, betrayal, ego, and love collide, pushing their relationship to the edge of divorce.
